people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
translations.bsb: And Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”
translations.kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear
translations.asv: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded that ye should do: and the glory of Jehovah shall appear unto you.
